reproduce: Launch Backend through Oracle javapath java.exe shim
Child JVM can remain alive and append Hikari logs after disposable MySQL removal
issue.actual: 7 verified se-d15 QA child JVMs were found: 3 earlier D15 runs and 4 targeted runs. Original parent-only cleanup statements did not establish JVM exit.
issue.resolution: Matched each PID to the exact DB-worktree Backend JAR and se-d15 temporary config, stopped only those 7 JVMs; confirmed zero matching JVMs remain. Future targeted harness uses taskkill /PID <owned launcher> /T /F before waiting.

historicalLogIntegrity.actual: Old Backend JVMs continued appending to three historical live-backend.log files; historical manifest hashes differ for those logs. Do not treat their current contents as immutable originals. All other historical manifest entries remain unchanged. Historical files/manifests were not rewritten to hide this drift.

targetedManifestIntegrity: Earlier r4 manifests also captured live-backend.log before final JVM stop; use final-manifest.json for current artifact hashes.
testValidity: 16 browser case results, AX snapshots and PNG unchanged. Cleanup was independently completed after the initial driver result; audit supersedes its premature Backend-stopped assertion.
harnessChangeAfterBrowserExecution: Only cleanup process-tree termination changed; no production source or financial/browser test behavior changed.

lastDockerRecheck.actual: Docker Desktop daemon pipe was unavailable at the final recheck. Before this, all four targeted docker rm calls succeeded, inspect confirmed container absence, and a successful docker ps label check returned zero QA containers. No Docker restart attempted.
